items.criterion: The health read returns a ready status.
items.judgment: The health endpoint answers 200.

items.criterion: The chapter list returns the published chapters in story order.
items.judgment: The chapter list answers 200 and carries no draft chapter.

items.criterion: A published chapter poster streams from the stored object under its key.
items.judgment: The poster read answers 200 and the object exists in the store under the chapter key.

items.criterion: Publishing a draft chapter opens its public read.
items.judgment: After publish the chapter reads back to the public in the story.

items.criterion: A member capture records the chapter and the title.
items.judgment: The capture answers 201 and one capture row carries the chapter and title.

items.criterion: A fresh session reads the same archive and reading position.
items.judgment: A second session for the member reads the same captures and reading position.

items.criterion: A member sets the order of the captures in a route.
items.judgment: The order write answers 200 and the captures take the requested order.

items.criterion: A member publishes a two-capture route to the public index.
items.judgment: After publish the route reads on the public index.

items.criterion: A curator features a published route.
items.judgment: The feature answers 200 and the route reads as featured.

items.criterion: The public story reconciles with the published chapter rows.
items.judgment: The listed chapters match the published rows in the database.

items.criterion: A first-visit cookie choice survives a reload.
items.judgment: The cookie preference persists and the notice is not shown again after a reload.

items.criterion: A signed-out request for a member endpoint is refused.
items.judgment: The anonymous member request answers 401 with not-signed-in.

items.criterion: A member request for a curator endpoint is refused.
items.judgment: The member curator request answers 403 with not-allowed-for-you.

items.criterion: A member writing a route they do not own is refused.
items.judgment: The cross-owner route write answers 403 with not-allowed-for-you and the route is unchanged.

items.criterion: A capture missing its title is refused.
items.judgment: The invalid capture answers 400 or 422 with something-missing-or-wrong and writes nothing.

items.criterion: A public read of a draft chapter is refused.
items.judgment: The draft chapter read answers 404 with no-such-thing.

items.criterion: A public read of a draft chapter poster is refused.
items.judgment: The draft poster read answers 404 with no-such-thing.

items.criterion: A public read of a draft route is refused.
items.judgment: The draft route read answers 404 with no-such-thing to a non-owner.

items.criterion: A route published with fewer than two captures is refused.
items.judgment: The undersized publish answers 409 with the-rules-dont-allow-that.

items.criterion: Each public route answers a distinct document title.
items.judgment: No two public routes answer the same title.

items.criterion: Every response carries the standard security headers.
items.judgment: A response carries a strict transport policy and a nosniff content-type policy.

items.criterion: No credential appears in a browser download.
items.judgment: The documents a browser fetches carry no bearer token or object-store key.

items.criterion: Each public route declares a social preview whose image resolves.
items.judgment: A public route declares a social preview image that reads back.
